model: An ideal disk electrode of unknown positive radius a with a dissolved analyte of unknown positive diffusivity D. The same unknown constant background current applies to all observations. In the declared early planar regime I(t)=I_bg+n*F*C*sqrt(pi)*a^2*sqrt(D)/sqrt(t). In the late steady disk regime I=I_bg+4*n*F*C*a*D. No kinetic limitation,ohmic drop,migration or other current is included. Use these equations exactly as the controlled reporting model.
validity_policy: After inferring a,D,check the supplied regime policy:max early t*D/a^2<=0.01and late t*D/a^2>=10. These thresholds define this controlled model-consistency screen;passing does not independently validate an actual electrode.
target: Fit the early free-intercept line against1/sqrt(t),then use its fitted background and the independent late observation to infer a,D. Return radius in micrometres,diffusivity in m²/s,background in A,early slope in A*sqrt(s),both dimensionless regime quantities and whether both criteria pass. Do not treat mol/m³as mol/Lor omit the disk geometric factors.

provenance.kind: Explicit controlled analytical/kinetic model;no experimental procedure or empirical parameter claim.
